title: observability-token-kv-tracing-metrics-dashboards-alert-tuning
author: Ethan Park
release_notes: Adds token-level KV cache metrics and tracing spans; updates Datadog dashboards; tunes alerts to reduce noise from cold-start spikes and token-cost regressions.
body: Summary: Add token-level KV cache metrics, expose KV hit/miss tags in tracing spans, update Datadog dashboards to include token-cost and latency breakdowns, and tune alerts to reduce noisy paging during cold-starts. Motivation: Customers need fine-grained observability to debug regressions in per-token cost and latency, and platform teams want correlated traces to investigate KV-cache effects on tail latency. This PR: - Adds new metrics: redwood.tokens.emitted, redwood.tokens.requested, redwood.kv.cache.hits, redwood.kv.cache.misses, redwood.kv.cache.hit_rate (tagged by model, route, customer_tier) - Emits per-request token cost/latency histogram with sampling at 1% by default to control cardinality - Adds tracing spans around KV operations and attaches cache_hit boolean + cache_ttl tags - Updates Datadog dashboard: token-level cost/latency heatmap, KV hit/miss per model, per-route latency waterfall - Introduces new alerts and tunes thresholds to avoid noise: * token-cost-regression-warning (SLO delta) * kv-cache-drop-hot (increased miss rate for sustained 2min) * token-latency-p50/p95 regression alerts with automatic rollback links - Adds unit/integration tests, and a small migration for backwards-compatible metric names Backwards compatibility: Metric names are additive and old metrics are preserved. No client-facing API changes. Checklist: - [x] Metric instrumentation added - [x] Tracing spans added with tags - [x] Dashboard JSON committed - [x] Alerts defined and tested in staging - [x] E2E cold-start test added and flake reviewed Related: ENG-4821 (token observability epic), ENG-4880 (kv cache tracing), SUP-2145 (customer report on token-cost spikes)
commits: feat(obs): add token-level token_metrics module and histograms
feat(obs): add KV tracing spans and attach cache_hit tag
docs(dashboards): add datadog token+kv dashboard JSON
test(obs): add integration test for KV miss surge alert
chore: small refactor of observability exports
review_comments: Maya Singh: Could you add sampling rationale for the per-request sample rate? I worry about cardinality - thanks.
Ethan Park: Added a note in the PR body and set default sampling to 1% with runtime override via DD_SAMPLING_RATE.
Liam O'Connor: Alert thresholds LGTM but suggest increasing the window for the kv-cache-drop-hot alert to 2 minutes to avoid transient noise.
Ethan Park: Increased window to 2m and added a suppression window during deploys (3m).
Zoe Martinez: Dashboard looks great — can we add a widget that correlates token-cost-regression with recent model rollouts?
Ethan Park: Added rollout tag and linked the widget to model_version and rollout_id.
Maya Singh: CI flaky test observed on e2e-coldstart-tests; reran and passed.
Liam O'Connor: Approved after minor nits addressed.
